name: Compodium International AB (publ)
summary: Compodium International AB (publ), a technology enterprise based in Luleå, Sweden, specializes in delivering digital collaboration platforms to businesses, public sector entities, and various organizations. Its primary offerings include Vidicue, an encrypted video conferencing solution engineered to safeguard highly sensitive and classified communications, and TDialog, a secure messaging service. The company further extends its portfolio with services encompassing fulfillment, project leadership, expert consultation, development and engineering, as well as green recycling and sustainability initiatives. It has been operational since its founding in 1997.
